name: io.github.shahriarbijoy/passwerk
title: passwerk
description: Offline EU Battery Passport compiler: ingest documents, map, validate (IDTA 02035), emit AASX.

environmentVariables.name: PASSWERK_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Directory ingest_documents may read and emit_passport may write (default: the working directory)

environmentVariables.name: PASSWERK_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: info (default) or debug; JSON lines on stderr
